description:
Describe one occupation or field of research and, on request, who is booked under it: its parent, children and crosswalk by default; `include: ["top_guests"]` ranks the guests listed under it by podcast appearances in a window (default the last 30 days, at most 90), and `include: ["top_podcasts"]` ranks the shows that booked them. `standing="established"` ranks only credentialed or recognized experts — "the shows that book established finance experts" is `field` plus top_podcasts plus standing. A broad code covers everything below it.

Take codes from `particle_expertise_resolve`, which turns free text ("doctors", "finance") into them; on `unresolved_reference` or `not_found`, resolve and retry. Guest slugs work with `particle_person_get` (`include: ["expertise"]`) and `particle_podcast_get_guest`; podcast slugs with every podcast tool.

For a multi-criteria guest search (practicing, seniority, capacity, employer, all-time) use `particle_podcast_list_guests`; for one show's guest mix use `particle_podcast_resolve` with `include: ["guest_expertise"]`.

field.description: A field of research's ANZSRC 2020 code, slug or title from particle_expertise_resolve (e.g. 'banking-finance-and-investment'). Pass exactly one of occupation or field.

include.description: Optional sections: 'top_guests' (the guests in the code most booked in the window, with appearances, shows and last appearance) and 'top_podcasts' (the shows that booked the code's guests most). Default is the code with its parent, children and crosswalk.

min_guests.description: top_podcasts keeps shows that booked at least this many distinct guests in the code in the window (default 1).

min_podcasts.description: top_guests keeps guests seen on at least this many distinct shows in the window (default 1); raise it to favor guests booked across the medium over a show's regulars.

occupation.description: An occupation's SOC 2018 or ISCO-08 code, slug or title from particle_expertise_resolve (e.g. 'cardiologists'). Pass exactly one of occupation or field.

output_format.description: Output serialization. 'markdown' (default) returns the LLM-facing rendering. 'json' returns the structured payload as JSON text — use only for programmatic chaining where exact field extraction matters; the JSON shape is larger and noisier for an LLM to read.

since.description: Window start for the top_ sections (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 30 days before until; the window may span at most 90 days.

standing.description: Rank only guests whose standing is recognized this way (e.g. 'established' for credentialed experts). Applies to the top_ sections.

until.description: Window end for the top_ sections (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Defaults to now.

name: particle_expertise_get
